subject: Request: Exec signoff for 25% Hosted API pilot incentive — BrightPort
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@brightport.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@brightport.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot pricing ask — BrightPort x Redwood

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — really excited by Redwood's latency profile and the KV caching you mentioned. We have internal approval to run a 6-month pilot targeting a conversational product for our enterprise verticals.

To make the economics work for our CFO, we need a 25% off list usage rate on Hosted API for the pilot period (we understand this is over 20% and requires senior approval). In return we can commit to a minimum of 1M tokens/month for the duration, plus a short case study and joint webinar if the pilot succeeds.

I've attached a short MOP and a forecast for your review. Can you confirm whether Redwood can sign off on a 25% incentive and, if so, how you prefer to structure the term in the contract?

Cheers,

Elena Rossi
Director of Product & Partnerships
BrightPort

Attachments: BrightPort_MOP_v2.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot pricing ask — BrightPort x Redwood (exec signoff requested)

Team — forwarding BrightPort's ask. TL;DR: 6-month pilot, request 25% off Hosted API usage (estimated 1M tokens/month). They explicitly flagged this as >20% so escalation needed. Opportunity looks strategic: they are tied to several large enterprise buyers and offered a case study + webinar. HubSpot link and forecast attached.

Key points:
- Ask: 25% off usage for 6 months (pilot only).
- Commit: 1M tokens/month minimum; potential to ramp if pilot goes well.
- Value: high referenceability in finance vertical; faster expansion likely if performance holds.
- Requirements: Redwood-owned SLA appendix for pilot; auto-convert to standard pricing after pilot unless renegotiated.

Ben — could you weigh in on market precedent here? Mina / Markus — need senior approval since this exceeds 20%. If approved, prefer conditions: limited term, explicit minimum spend, and clear auto-convert clause. Also request CS enablement (Laura) to own onboarding.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: Q4_forecast_brightport.xlsx, BrightPort_MOP_v2.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot pricing ask — BrightPort x Redwood (exec signoff requested)

Vanessa — thanks for the summary. A few clarifying Qs from my end before we ask Markus/Mina to greenlight:
1) Is the 1M tokens/month a hard minimum for them or flexible with ramp clauses?
2) Any request on model family (we need to confirm which model they want to run on Hosted — larger models change unit economics).
3) Can they accept a conversion clause: pilot rates revert to list pricing unless they sign a 12-month committed plan?

Vanessa replied inline earlier but to be explicit:
- They stated 1M/mo minimum but are open to a ramp structure with an initial minimum and a 30-day performance review.
- They prefer Redwood's Llama-2-70B-quant variant for accuracy; that will increase token cost baseline (~15% higher than base model).
- They agreed to auto-convert to list pricing after pilot unless we agree to a new committed discount.

If we're comfortable factoring model mix, this still looks like a reasonable strategic concession given their reference value. Suggest approval with conditions: 25% cap for pilot only, explicit minimum monthly spend invoiceable, and CS SLA + success metrics.

Ben Carter
VP, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot pricing ask — BrightPort x Redwood (exec signoff requested)

Approvable with constraints — Markus K.

I've reviewed the ask and the upside. Approved for a one-time, timeboxed 25% Hosted API usage incentive for the pilot under the following mandatory conditions:

1) Term: 6 months max. Any extension requires documented senior approval.
2) Minimums: Invoiceable minimum of 1,000,000 tokens per month. If they underdeliver we still invoice the minimum.
3) Model / pricing adjustment: Pilot pricing will be applied to their chosen production model variant; legal must reflect model family and potential surcharge for larger model use. Finance to model expected realized revenue with Llama-2-70B-quant pricing before contract signature (Mina).
4) Auto-convert: Explicit contract clause that pilot rates automatically revert to standard list pricing at the end of the pilot unless a new committed-rate deal is executed.
5) Go/no-go: CS (Laura) must confirm onboarding and success criteria (SLOs and metrics) in writing prior to pilot start.
6) Marketing: BrightPort must agree to a short case study and a joint webinar if pilot KPIs are met.

Mina — please prepare the contract rider language and model the P&L impact for the quarter. Laura — schedule onboarding resources. Ben/Vanessa — proceed to get internal signoffs and route final contract through Legal with the above clauses.

Markus Klein
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
